name: 46816 · Fort Wayne, IN
findings: ZIP 46816 (Fort Wayne) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46816 (Fort Wayne) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46816 (Fort Wayne) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
